# Book records (`BOOK`)

The catalogue of titles the library holds, the physical copies of each, and who may change them.

**Spec status:** specified

## Requirements

### REQ-BOOK-001

A librarian shall be able to add a title to the catalogue by supplying its ISBN, title, author and publication year, and the system shall reject a title whose ISBN already exists in the catalogue.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-001-1` | a catalogue with no title for ISBN 9780261102217 | a librarian adds that ISBN with a title, author and year | the title is in the catalogue with zero copies and is returned by a search for that ISBN |
| `AC-BOOK-001-2` | a catalogue already holding ISBN 9780261102217 | a librarian adds that ISBN again | the request is rejected with error ISBN_ALREADY_EXISTS and the catalogue is unchanged |
| `AC-BOOK-001-3` | a catalogue with no title for a given ISBN | a librarian adds it with the publication year left empty | the request is rejected with error FIELD_REQUIRED naming publicationYear |

### REQ-BOOK-002

A librarian shall be able to add a physical copy to an existing title, and the system shall assign that copy a barcode unique across the library.

**Risk:** medium

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-002-1` | a title with two copies | a librarian adds a third copy | the title reports three copies and the new copy has a barcode held by no other copy |
| `AC-BOOK-002-2` | a copy barcode already in use | a librarian adds a copy with that barcode | the request is rejected with error BARCODE_IN_USE |

### REQ-BOOK-003

A librarian shall be able to change a title's title, author and publication year, and the system shall preserve its ISBN, its copies and their loan history.

**Risk:** low

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-003-1` | a title with three copies, one on loan | a librarian corrects the author's spelling | the author is updated and the title still reports three copies with the same loan still open |
| `AC-BOOK-003-2` | an existing title | a librarian attempts to change its ISBN | the request is rejected with error ISBN_IMMUTABLE |

### REQ-BOOK-004

A librarian shall be able to remove a copy from the catalogue, and the system shall refuse to remove a copy that is currently on loan.

**Risk:** high

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-004-1` | a copy that is on the shelf | a librarian removes it | the copy is gone from the catalogue and the title reports one fewer copy |
| `AC-BOOK-004-2` | a copy that is on loan to a member | a librarian removes it | the request is rejected with error COPY_ON_LOAN and the loan is unchanged |
| `AC-BOOK-004-3` | a title whose last remaining copy is removed | a librarian removes that copy | the title remains in the catalogue with zero copies and is marked unavailable in search results |

### REQ-BOOK-005

Any authenticated user shall be able to search the catalogue by title, author or ISBN, and the system shall return results in pages of at most 50 with the total number of matches.

**Risk:** low

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-005-1` | a catalogue of 120 titles whose author is "Le Guin" | a member searches for author "Le Guin" without naming a page | the first 50 matches are returned along with a total of 120 |
| `AC-BOOK-005-2` | the same search | the member asks for the third page | matches 101 to 120 are returned along with a total of 120 |
| `AC-BOOK-005-3` | a catalogue with no match for the search term | a member searches for it | an empty result is returned with a total of 0 and not an error |

### REQ-BOOK-006

The system shall report, for each title in a search result, how many of its copies are on the shelf.

**Risk:** low

| Criterion | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AC-BOOK-006-1` | a title with three copies, two of them on loan | a member searches and the title matches | the result reports one copy available of three |
| `AC-BOOK-006-2` | a title whose every copy is on loan | a member searches and the title matches | the result reports zero copies available and the title is still listed |
